classes.DERIVE: populate from internal data without asking the sender; eligible for D1_AUTO_REPAIR
classes.VERIFY: cannot populate safely; validate, contradict, or constrain the submitted value
classes.ASK: no internal source; must come from the prescriber's office (D2/D3)

sources.ELIG: member eligibility / benefits engine (roster, subscriber, plan, group, BIN/PCN, coverage)
sources.CLAIMS_RX: pharmacy claims history incl. fill dates, days supply, run-out
sources.CLAIMS_MED: medical claims (diagnosis, site of care, some vitals)
sources.DIR: provider directory maintained by network operations
sources.DRUG: drug master / formulary / NDC package data
sources.PLAN: plan benefit design rules (days supply, substitution, site of care)
sources.REMS: REMS or manufacturer hub enrollment records

CORROBORATE ONLY. A claims code is a billing artifact - it may be a rule-out, a historical code, or an encounter Z-code. The enrollment code is an attestation of medical necessity; filling it for the prescriber moves clinical and legal liability onto the pharmacy. Use claims only to flag implausibility
